teaser: Search as a walk through the newsroom's graph: chips, exact suggestions, five views and a pane that shows the working, with no model yet.
core_idea: The site now has a graph per article, a summary per section, figures and trails, so search should become navigation: a query built from chips with exact suggestions, five views of one result and a pane showing the working, all deterministic in the browser; the taxonomy debt is the work, and the hypothesis is that a clean graph needs less model and serves a model better than vectors.

quotes.text: That is not a reason to reach for a model. It is the work.
A search that can show its working is one you can trust, and one you can improve

figures.caption: Search as navigation. A query built from chips, Portugal and startups, each resolved to a thing in the graph; on the side, what the words could mean, what sits nearest and which combinations are worth following, each with an exact count; in the middle, the views of the same result: the graph, the sections as one-liners, a collage of the figures, a timeline and the ranked list; and a pane that shows what was fetched, how each result arrived and the time each step took. All of it in the browser, from files built at release, with no model.
